metadata.literal_pointer: PDF page 33, 'Connectivity Division updates', bullet 'Keppel DC SGP 9 commenced construction'. The same slide's portfolio table is labelled 'As at end-Jun 2026'.
metadata.date_semantics: July 30 is the presentation's publication date. The bullet sits in first-half divisional updates beside a portfolio table labelled as at end-June; the later publication date is selected conservatively as the date by which construction had commenced. September retrieval does not refresh it.
metadata.authority_basis: The developer's own results presentation reporting the start of physical construction of the named building.
metadata.physical_status_scope: Broad under_construction for the new SGP 9 building only. The operating SGP 7 and SGP 8 buildings on the same campus are not selected. No completion percentage, capacity or energization is inferred.
metadata.successor_review: Construction commenced in 2026, so completion by August 20 is implausible; the research lane found no opening or cancellation, and reported that Keppel's 1Q 2026 update expected construction to begin in mid-2026. The 2024 REIT filing said construction had not commenced. Bounded, not exhaustive.
metadata.corroboration: Keppel's July 30 results page (tmp/research-round41-apac/r41-apac-keppel-1h2026-results-page.html) says the division continued to advance development of SGP 9.

evidence.excerpt: The REIT announcement locates KDC SGP 7 and SGP 8 at 82 Genting Lane, Singapore 349567, and states that a planned third data centre, KDC SGP 9, is to be developed on the same property.
